# School, College and University Management Platforms 2026: Top 20 Worldwide, Top 10 India, Full Dossiers and an Open-Source Blueprint to Beat Them

**Author:** Manus AI
**Date:** November 2026 (evidence checked 24–27 November 2026)
**Scope:** student information systems (SIS), school management information systems (MIS), school ERP and campus/university ERP platforms for K-12 schools, independent and international schools, colleges and universities.

## How to Read This Report

This report has three jobs. First, it ranks the 20 strongest school, college and university management platforms worldwide, plus a separate top 10 of Indian platforms, using one published scoring rubric. Second, it gives a complete dossier for every ranked platform. Each dossier covers the vendor, headquarters, creation year, platform classification (web, cloud, desktop, mobile, on-premise), full feature inventory, advanced features, pricing, integrations, security, strengths, weaknesses, milestones and a numbered reference list. Third, it turns the evidence into a blueprint for a new open-source "one platform for all" that schools, colleges and universities can move to easily.

All links are full, visible URLs, never hidden behind link text. Bracketed numbers such as [3] in each dossier point to that dossier's own numbered reference list.

**Table of contents**

1. How to Read This Report, Executive Summary, Methodology and Ranking Tables (this section)
2. Part I. Top 20 Worldwide Platforms: Full Profiles (#1 to #20)
3. Part II. Top 10 Indian Platforms: Full Profiles (India #1 to India #10)
4. Part III. Also Evaluated: Full Profiles of the 10 Candidates That Did Not Make the Lists
5. Part IV. Backend Teardown of the Top 3 System-of-Record Platforms (REA-assisted)
6. Part V. Blueprint: "OpenCampus One", an Open-Source Platform Designed to Beat Every Platform in This Report
7. Appendix A. Interoperability, Privacy, Accessibility, Security and India Digital Public Infrastructure Requirements
8. Appendix B. Open-Source Technical Approach, Free Tiers and Deployment Costs
9. Appendix C. Market Size, Consolidation, Security Incidents and Buyer Pain Points

## Executive Summary

**Worldwide leaders.** PowerSchool SIS is ranked #1 (weighted score 8.8 out of 10). It has the broadest K-12 feature set and the largest footprint: 15,000+ organizations, 60M+ students and 90+ countries, per company claims. Ellucian is #2 (8.4). It is the dominant higher-education system of record, with about 3,000 institutions in 50 countries, and it absorbed Anthology's SIS/ERP business on 31 December 2025. Arbor is #3 (8.2). It is the fastest-moving cloud MIS and held 53.58% of English state schools in the May 2026 census analysis. Alma, FACTS, Workday Student, Synergy, Veracross, Focus and Blackbaud complete the top 10.

**Indian leaders.** MasterSoft ERP is India #1 (7.9). It has the broadest higher-education and accreditation (NAAC/NBA/OBE) coverage. Camu is India #2 (7.8), with the most modern cloud and mobile experience. Fedena is India #3 (7.6), with the largest claimed footprint (40,000+ institutions) and transparent pricing. NextOS (#4) and Academia ERP by Serosoft (#5) follow.

**Market truth.** Across all 40 platforms reviewed, the same weaknesses keep appearing:

- Enterprise pricing is quote-only and hard to compare.
- Implementation takes months.
- Interfaces are dated, and mobile apps are often poorly rated.
- Reporting is rigid.
- Data lock-in and costly exits are common.
- Recent security incidents include PowerSchool (December 2024), Blackbaud (2020), Illuminate (2021, FTC action in 2025) and Frontline (2026).
- India-specific compliance coverage is weak: UDISE+, APAAR, ABC, DigiLocker and the DPDP Act 2023 with the DPDP Rules 2025.

Part V converts these gaps into a feature-by-feature blueprint. The core rule is that every proposed feature must fix a documented competitor gap.

## Selection and Ranking Methodology

**Candidate pool.** We researched 40 platforms in depth: 25 worldwide and 15 Indian. The pool combines the most-cited global SIS/MIS/ERP vendors, the market-share leaders in the US, UK, Australia and international-school segments, the higher-education ERP leaders, and every candidate in the guide you supplied. Each platform got its own research pass using official vendor pages, documentation, pricing pages, press releases, government procurement documents (for example UK G-Cloud rate cards), app-store listings and review platforms. Pure LMS products such as Canvas, Moodle and Google Classroom were excluded from ranking and treated as integration targets.

**Scoring rubric (0–10 per dimension, fixed weights):**

| Dimension | Weight | What it measures |
|---|---:|---|
| Feature breadth | 30% | Coverage of admissions, records, attendance, timetable, gradebook/exams, LMS, communications, portals, fees/finance, HR/payroll, transport, health, behaviour, special education, analytics and compliance |
| Adoption ("most used") | 30% | Institutions, students and countries served, market share and procurement wins, with dated sources |
| Advanced features | 20% | AI, predictive analytics, early-warning, workflow automation, advanced scheduling, standards certification and other distinctive capabilities |
| UX and mobile | 10% | Interface modernity, native app quality and app-store ratings, accessibility |
| Interoperability | 10% | Open APIs, OneRoster/LTI/Ed-Fi/SIF/CASE, SSO, marketplace and data export |

Weighted score = 0.30 × breadth + 0.30 × adoption + 0.20 × advanced + 0.10 × UX + 0.10 × interoperability. Ties are broken by adoption, then advanced features. The ranking was computed with the deterministic script in the edtech-platform-research skill. Global and Indian lists were ranked separately; an Indian platform appears only in the Indian list.

**Important caveats.** Adoption figures are mostly vendor claims and are labelled as such in each dossier. A low UX score sometimes reflects poorly rated companion apps (for example Arbor, Bromcom and Synergy) rather than a poor core web interface. Most enterprise vendors publish no prices, so pricing is quote-only unless an official figure is cited.

**Pricing insight.** In the US, prices are enterprise quotes with large implementation projects. UK public procurement shows base fee plus per-pupil pricing (about £3–£12 per pupil per year). In India, flat school plans and per-student tiers dominate, often under ₹100–₹500 per student per year. The blueprint uses this to propose a free self-hosted core plus transparent, published hosted pricing.

## Corrections and Updates to the Guide You Supplied

Your guide was researched candidate by candidate. These differences matter for decisions:

1. **Ranking changes.** Our global top 20 adds Workday Student (#6), Bromcom (#11), Jenzabar (#12) and Anthology Student (#19) because of their adoption and higher-education depth. Aeries, Gradelink, ManageBac+ and Gibbon move to Part III, and their full profiles are kept. Our India top 10 adds MasterSoft ERP (#1) and Academia ERP (#5). Teachmint and Edunext move to Part III.
2. **Infinite Campus** ranks #13 here, not #2. It scores high on adoption (11M students, 46 states) but lower on advanced features and app experience under the rubric. It is still analysed as one of the "top 3" system-of-record backends in Part IV, because its footprint and hosting model are among the most instructive.
3. **Arbor** now leads the English state-school market: 53.58% (11,787 schools) in the May 2026 census analysis, against SIMS 26.28% and Bromcom 17.60%. The guide's G-Cloud 15 (September 2026) price figures could not be independently confirmed in this research. The Arbor dossier uses the official G-Cloud 14 rate card and labels it historical.
4. **Anthology Student** is now owned by Ellucian. The acquisition of Anthology's SIS/ERP business completed 31 December 2025 and was announced 5 January 2026.
5. **Entab** was acquired by Nelnet Business Services effective 1 October 2026. Nelnet's announcement cites 1,000+ schools and 1.5M+ students, lower than Entab's own 2,300–2,500+ school claims.
6. **Teachmint's** official pages state that the standalone admission and fee-management solutions are no longer available. Schools expecting a classic ERP should treat those as discontinued.
7. **MyClassCampus** was acquired by Teachmint in January 2022. Its domain now presents Teachmint X, so it is no longer evaluated as an independent ERP.
8. **Focus School Software:** the guide's "$3,000 SourceForge" figure could not be verified and is not treated as subscription pricing.
9. **Gradelink:** the official calculator showed $106/month + $275 setup on 24 November 2026, matching the guide. The company founding year is reported as 2001 by LinkedIn and Crunchbase, while the homepage implies 2002 ("24 years").
10. **Gibbon** publishes no verified institution or student count, so its adoption score is low despite real worldwide use.

| Review ratings (G2, Capterra, App Store, Play Store with score, review count and date viewed) | Viewed November 24, 2026: G2 PowerSchool SIS 4.2/5 from 742 reviews (updated November 4, 2026); Capterra SIS 4.3/5 from 143 reviews (updated October 21, 2026); Apple PowerSchool Mobile 4.6/5 from 947K ratings; Google Play PowerSchool Mobile 2.5/5 from 39.6K reviews. App-store figures are for the companion app. [18] [19] [21] [22] |

### Overview

PowerSchool SIS is the administrative system of record in a much broader K-12 portfolio. It centralizes enrollment, student and family records, attendance, schedules, grades, reports, fees, portals and state/provincial workflows, then connects those records to Schoology Learning, Performance Matters, Special Programs, Behavior Support, MTSS, Naviance CCLR, SchoolMessenger, analytics, HR and ERP products. [2] [3] [4]

The original SIS was developed in 1997, acquired by Apple in 2001 and Pearson in 2006, sold to Vista Equity Partners in 2015 for $350 million, taken public in 2021 and taken private again by Bain Capital on October 1, 2024 for approximately $5.6 billion. [6] [16] [25] [26]

### Platform Classification Explained

The core system is browser-accessed cloud software. PowerSchool describes its products as cloud-based; Analytics & Insights/MTSS materials describe cloud hosting, disaster recovery, 24/7/365 monitoring and up to 99.9% uptime. The privacy statement names AWS, Microsoft Azure, Oracle, Snowflake and Microsoft SQL infrastructure and says most customer data is hosted in the United States, with some products in Canada. [12] [14] [15]

The web Parent/Student Portal is accessible anywhere, while PowerSchool Mobile is native for iPhone/iPad/Apple Watch and Android. The ecosystem also has Schoology, SchoolMessenger, eSchoolPLUS Family, Unified Classroom Behavior, PowerSchool ERP Employee and Planboard apps. [21] [22] [23] No current desktop client or customer-managed on-premise SIS was evidenced.

### Complete Feature Inventory

#### Admissions and enrollment

PowerSchool Enrollment provides mobile-friendly, multilingual registration, configurable fields, workflows, document/form uploads, reenrollment, verification and automated SIS transfer. The flagship product is SIS-agnostic and supports school-choice/lottery processes; Enrollment Express works inside PowerSchool SIS. The vendor reports 3,500+ districts and 98M+ enrollment packets in 2025. [7]

#### Student information and records

SIS maintains demographics, contacts, programs, school/course history, schedules, alerts, logs, secure notes, data validation and reporting terms. Administrators get advanced/compound/wildcard/stored searches, configurable pages, tables and fields, mass entry, code sets, special operations and field-level security. [3] [13]

#### Attendance

Native features include daily/period attendance, attendance codes, bell schedules, teacher entry, searches, reports and family visibility. SchoolMessenger SafeArrival adds absence reporting and follow-up; Analytics and MTSS connect attendance to profiles and interventions. [3] [9] [12]

#### Timetable and master scheduling

The SIS manages periods, bell schedules, course sections, class and student schedules, with schedule visibility in portals and mobile. Public documentation confirms schedule administration, but detailed master-scheduling implementation is largely customer documentation/services material. [3] [13]

#### Gradebook, assessment and examinations

PowerTeacher Pro supports assignments, grades, comments, standards-based/traditional grading, attendance and class data. Schoology adds assignments, discussions, standards mastery and conditional release. Performance Matters adds item banks, collaborative/online, paper, observational and performance assessments, accommodations, standards/item/student reporting, LockDown Browser, Kiosk Mode, AI item creation and rubric scoring. [4] [28]

#### Report cards and transcripts

SIS supports customizable reports, report cards, transcripts, GPA/class rank, schedules, history and state reporting. Schoology standards passback and Naviance electronic transcript/document sharing extend records into instruction and post-secondary workflows. [3] [11] [13]

#### Learning management and homework

Schoology Learning provides courses, curriculum, assignments, assessments, discussions, groups, templates, lesson planning, standards mastery, differentiated instruction, conditional release and family visibility. It integrates with SIS, Performance Matters, C&I, MTSS, Behavior, Naviance and analytics, plus Google Drive/Assignments, Microsoft Office/Assignments, LTI and OneRoster 1.2. [4]

#### Communication (SMS, email, push, WhatsApp)

SchoolMessenger supports phone, email, SMS/text, app and web messaging; mass/emergency alerts; two-way staff-family conversations; classroom posts; websites; events; multilingual behavior messaging; attendance alerts; and SecureFile delivery of report cards/schedules. WhatsApp was not identified as a native channel in reviewed official materials. [9]

#### Parent, student and teacher portals

The web Parent/Student Portal supports multiple children, grades, assignments, scores, attendance, GPA where enabled, schedules, bulletins, fees, meal balances and notifications. PowerTeacher Pro is the teacher workspace. District administrators control which portal features are enabled. [3] [23]

#### Fees, billing, payments and accounting

SIS includes student fees, meal/fee balances, transactions and mobile collection. ERP covers fund accounting, chart of accounts, budgets, encumbrances, general ledger, payables, receivables, contracts, fixed assets, grants/projects, purchasing and 400+ native K-12 reports. Named payment/invoicing subprocessors include Vanco, NMI, Authorize.Net, Worldpay and Stripe. [6] [15]

#### HR, staff and payroll

Recruiting/HR covers job distribution, applications, screening, interviews, hiring, onboarding, employee records and substitute management. ERP adds employee information, compensation, benefits, attendance, schedules, development, self-service and mobile access; payroll scope varies by licensed product. [6] [29]

#### Transport

SIS administrator resources include bus-route search, and the partner directory includes transportation integrations such as BatOnRoute. Public material does not establish a full native fleet-optimization/GPS module in SIS itself. [13] [14]

#### Inventory and assets

SIS documents asset management, inventory creation and checkout. ERP supports purchasing and fixed assets; SIS reporting can expose asset data alongside student and operational records. [6] [13]

#### Health and medical

Enrollment collects configurable health/safety/contact data; SIS reports include health and alerts, and health-center integrations appear in the partner directory. A complete clinical-record product was not evidenced as a standalone native module. [3] [7] [14]

#### Behavior, discipline and pastoral care

Behavior Support provides PBIS/SEL records, positive/corrective/neutral/referral dashboards, positivity ratios, trends by grade/location/time/group, family messaging and translation. MTSS adds profiles, goals, student plans, Tier 1–3 interventions, notes, attachments, progress charts and intervention-session attendance. [10] [12]

#### Special education and safeguarding

Special Programs covers IEP, 504, ELL, gifted/talented, service capture, digital signatures, forms, case management, deadlines, alerts, dashboards, family access and role-based documents. PowerSchool states it supports 25 state-specific models plus a federal model configurable for all 50 states. [8]

#### Analytics, dashboards and reporting

Analytics & Insights provides research-based dashboards, ad hoc reporting, role/row security, filters by school, grade, staff, ethnicity, gender, program and group, customizable KPIs/layouts/visualizations/language, historical profiles and individualized plans. It reports 560+ districts and 50,000+ interventions created in 2025. Connected Intelligence consolidates data for analytics and natural-language analysis. [5] [27]

#### AI features

PowerBuddy is a production assistant for students, teachers, families, administrators, college/career users and analysts. Features include conversational tutoring, lesson/assessment drafting, standards-aligned content, recommendations, college/career exploration, recommendation-letter drafting, natural-language data analysis, item generation and AI rubric scoring. [10] [28]

#### Government/state reporting and compliance

SIS provides state/provincial reporting, data validation, reporting terms and compliance-oriented attendance, behavior, health, graduation and demographic reports. The SIS page claims support for 56 states/provinces; exact packages vary by jurisdiction. [3] [13]

#### Mobile apps

PowerSchool Mobile provides dashboard widgets for GPA, classes, assignments, attendance, bulletins, meal balance and fees; grade/attendance push notifications; teacher comments; calendars; schedules; and multi-child account linking. Separate apps include Schoology, SchoolMessenger, ERP Employee, Unified Classroom Behavior, eSchoolPLUS Family and Planboard. [21] [22] [23]

#### Integrations and APIs

PowerSchool advertises 75+ certified SIS integrations and a large partner directory covering learning, assessment, health, payments, transportation, library, cafeteria, safety and HR. Examples include Clever, Canvas, MasteryConnect, SNAP Health Center, Wonde and Vanco. A detailed, universally documented public SIS REST API contract was not located; buyers should validate API, sandbox, export, webhook and rate-limit terms. [4] [14] [18]

### Advanced and Distinctive Features

- **Connected Operating System:** unifies home, classroom, student support and central-office work. [2]
- **Contextual PowerBuddy AI:** spans tutoring, teacher planning, administration, CCLR, assessment and data analysis. [10]
- **Whole-child intervention loop:** combines attendance, assessment, behavior, MTSS, Special Programs and analytics. [5] [8] [12]
- **No-code configuration:** Enrollment, MTSS and Special Programs expose configurable fields, forms, plans and workflows. [7] [8] [12]
- **Large K-12 scale:** 15,000+ organizations/60M+ students claimed, with 56 states/provinces and 90+ countries in dated claims. [3] [6] [16]
- **Integrated ERP and workforce layer:** connects enrollment, budgets, HR, purchasing, payroll and staffing planning. [6]

### Pricing Details

No official public price list, tier table, per-student/year rate or implementation-fee schedule was found. PowerSchool directs prospects to a sales expert, so SIS, Schoology, Enrollment, analytics, ERP, support, implementation and add-ons are quote-based and configuration-dependent. [30]

Capterra’s listing, updated September 29, 2026, displays **$7 “Flat Rate”**, no free trial and no comparable unit such as student/year or school/month; treat it only as a marketplace estimate. G2 shows a five-dollar-sign perceived-cost indicator and three-month average implementation time from reviewers, not vendor pricing. [18] [20]

### Integrations, Standards and Interoperability

Public evidence includes Schoology OneRoster 1.2, LTI, Google/Microsoft integrations, 75+ certified SIS integrations, a large partner directory and 1EdTech TrustEd App verification. The 1EdTech vendor page confirms PowerSchool Group LLC membership but does not expose a simple current list of every active certification. Clever/ClassLink are relevant ecosystem options, but Ed-Fi, SIF and a universally documented public SIS API were not verified in the opened pages. [4] [14] [24]

### Security, Privacy and Compliance

PowerSchool reports ISO 27001:2022, annual SOC 2 Type 2 examinations, 1EdTech TrustEd App verification, MFA, role-based controls, 24/7/365 security operations, logging, vulnerability scanning and 30+ annual penetration tests. It cites FERPA, COPPA and applicable state/provincial/federal privacy rules and describes itself as a FERPA school official/processor when handling education records. [14] [15]

The privacy statement says most customer data is hosted in the United States, lists AWS/Azure/Snowflake/Oracle subprocessors and describes international transfers using the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework where applicable. It references GDPR/international privacy alignment, but India’s DPDP Act was not expressly named in the reviewed public pages and should be confirmed contractually. [15]

**Breach chronology:** PowerSchool says it detected unauthorized exfiltration from certain SIS environments through the PowerSource support portal on December 28, 2024; notified affected SIS customers January 7, 2025; began applicable regulator/attorney-general notifications January 27; and issued a final update March 7. Potential data included name, contact information, date of birth, limited medical-alert information, SSN/SIN and related information, varying by person. PowerSchool reported no evidence of credit-card/bank data, other products being affected or continuing unauthorized activity. It offered two years of identity protection and adult credit monitoring; enrollment closed July 31, 2025. [27] [28]

### Strengths

- Broad K-12 coverage from SIS through LMS, assessment, special programs, communications, interventions, CCLR, analytics, ERP and HR. [2]
- Exceptional scale and procurement familiarity, with 15,000+/60M+ and 18,000+/90+ dated company claims. [6] [16]
- Strong standards/partner story through OneRoster, LTI, Google/Microsoft and 75+ integrations. [4] [14]
- Deep configurability in SIS pages/fields, reports, enrollment forms, intervention plans and special-program workflows. [3] [7] [8] [12]
- Production AI rather than a roadmap-only announcement. [10] [28]
- Native mobile access, although quality differs sharply between iOS and Android. [21] [22]

### Weaknesses and Common User Complaints

- G2 and Capterra reviews cite learning difficulty, technical issues, too many screens, confusing navigation and a feature set that intimidates new users. [18] [19]
- Reviewers report extra training/plugin costs, while official pricing is quote-only. [19] [20] [30]
- Capterra cites obtuse Enrollment migration/year rollover; G2 requests simpler reporting, more dependable sync and easier bulk workflows. [18] [19]
- Mobile reliability is polarized: Apple is 4.6/947K, but Google Play is 2.5/39.6K, with complaints about crashes, stale grades and notifications. Apple reviews also cite “missing” assignment confusion and sync delays. [21] [22]
- A 2026 G2 reviewer described a failed multi-district merge, billing problems and substantial customer-side cleanup; this is an individual account, not proof of a systemic failure. [18]
- The 2024/2025 SIS breach is a material trust weakness for a platform holding sensitive student, educator and limited medical data, even though PowerSchool reported no operational disruption. [27] [28]
- Library, hostel/boarding and alumni/fundraising were not substantiated as native SIS modules; treat them as partner or adjacent-system requirements.

### Key Milestones

- **1997:** PowerSchool developed. [25]
- **2001 / 2006:** Acquired by Apple, then Pearson. [25]
- **2015:** Vista agreed to acquire Pearson’s PowerSchool for $350 million; reporting cited 4,200 customers, 13M students and 70 countries. [25]
- **2021:** PowerSchool debuted on the NYSE in July. [26]
- **June/October 2024:** Bain announced and then completed the approximately $5.6B take-private at $22.80 per share; Vista and Onex retained minority investments. [16] [17] [26]
- **2024:** PowerBuddy won a GESS Best AI Product award. [10]
- **December 28, 2024–March 7, 2025:** SIS breach detected, customers/regulators notified, and final incident update issued; monitoring closed July 31, 2025. [27] [28]
- **2025:** Vendor pages reported 50,000+ Analytics interventions and 98M+ Enrollment packets. [5] [7]
- **2026:** Customer Central listed 5,890 articles and current SIS administration resources. [13]

### Overview

Ellucian is a higher-education ERP/SIS portfolio rather than a general K–12 school-management product. Its legacy anchors are Banner and Colleague, now being repositioned inside Ellucian Student and the broader Ellucian SaaS Platform. The platform connects student records, recruiting and admissions, financial aid, advising, degree audit, finance, HCM, analytics, communications, workflow automation and advancement. It matters because the system of record is integrated with the operating systems that colleges use for enrollment, billing, compliance and completion—not just classroom administration. [2] [3]

The company’s history is older than the Ellucian name. Datatel was established in 1968; SCT introduced Banner and Datatel began developing Colleague in 1979. SunGard acquired SCT in 2004, and Datatel and SunGard Higher Education combined in 2012; the new name Ellucian was announced in March 2012. [4] [24] Since then, Ellucian has emphasized SaaS: its 2024 release said more than 2,000 institutions used its SaaS solutions, while its current site claims about 3,000 customers and 21M+ students. Acquisitions broadened the stack, including CampusLogic in 2022, EduNav in 2024 and Anthology’s SIS/ERP business, closed December 31, 2025 and reported in January 2026. [5] [25]

### Platform Classification Explained

* **Browser/web access:** Central Workspace (the current Experience-style digital hub) is a role-based web experience for students, faculty, staff and executives, presenting classes, grades, schedules, tasks, payroll, advising, dashboards and alerts with fewer logins. [9]
* **Cloud hosting/SaaS:** Ellucian markets Banner and Colleague SaaS and says its cloud services use AWS security controls such as GuardDuty, Inspector, WAF, Shield and Splunk monitoring. The SaaS offer provides continuous updates and reduced local maintenance. [5] [7]
* **Legacy on-premise/hybrid:** Banner and Colleague have long-running installed estates and the vendor sells professional services for SaaS transitions. Therefore the practical installed base is hybrid during migration, even though the strategic direction is SaaS. The company does not publish a simple public matrix of every legacy deployment option. [5] [8]
* **Desktop client:** No current native desktop client is advertised as a core delivery mode on the public product catalog. Older Banner/Colleague administrative interfaces and institution-specific tooling may remain in use, but the current documented access model is browser plus SaaS services. [2] [8]
* **Native mobile:** Ellucian Mobile/Ellucian Go is delivered as institution-branded iOS/Android apps rather than one universal consumer app. The App Store example opened for UL Lafayette exposes courses, grades, account balance/payment, news, events and social links; Google Play’s Ellucian developer page lists a vendor testing package. [23]

### Complete Feature Inventory

#### Admissions and enrollment

Recruiting & Admissions/CRM Recruit covers early lead generation, micro-scholarships, one-to-one engagement from as early as ninth grade, prospect scoring, decision assignment, segmentation, campaigns and yield/access analytics. Application Management adds password-free multi-factor authentication, application review, fraud/duplicate checks, transcript and net-price workflows. International Student Management tracks visas, immigration cases, deadlines, global applicant workflows and international enrollment reporting. [13]

#### Student information and records

Banner Student and Colleague Student provide the higher-education SIS core: person and biographical records, academic history, programs and curricula, catalog/course data, registration, holds, enrollment status, transfer credit, institutional records and self-service. Ellucian Student describes a unified system that joins student services and gives students and faculty self-service with real-time information and compliance controls. [3] [8]

#### Attendance

Attendance is not marketed as a standalone K–12 attendance module. Banner faculty self-service materials and independent review evidence describe class-list and attendance-tracking capabilities, so attendance exists in a limited academic/faculty context. Daily homeroom, parent absence workflows and school attendance registers are not publicly documented as native Ellucian functions. [8] [22]

#### Timetable and master scheduling

Ellucian supports course demand analysis, course-seat planning, registration policies and adaptive/flexible scheduling through Student Success, Smart Planning and Registration, and Lifelong Learning. Plans can connect registration to sequencing, cost and anticipated completion date. A separate school-style master-timetable and room-scheduling module is not clearly listed in the public product catalog. [3] [14]

#### Gradebook, assessment and examinations

Faculty self-service supports class lists, schedules and grade entry; academic records feed degree audit and student progress. Ellucian’s public pages do not describe a full LMS-gradebook, online examination engine or K–12 assessment bank, so those functions normally require a learning platform or specialist integration. [8] [22]

#### Report cards and transcripts

Student records, grades, academic profiles, degree evaluation and official transcripts are supported. Transcript Exchange provides secure, real-time transcript ordering, fulfillment and authentication for transfer, admissions and enrollment; the platform also exposes document management and intelligent transcript capture. Traditional K–12 report-card templates are not a central product claim. [2] [3] [8]

#### Learning management and homework

Ellucian is not an LMS and does not advertise native homework, lesson delivery or assignment authoring. Its role is SIS/ERP and integration: Capterra review data names Canvas among connected tools, and the platform’s low-code data orchestration is designed to connect LMS systems. [12] [22]

#### Communication (SMS, email, push, WhatsApp)

Ellucian Communicate manages lifecycle communication history and multi-channel campaigns across recruitment, enrollment, study, continuing education and advancement. Supported channels named by Ellucian are SMS, email and in-app push; recruiting pages also mention text, email, chat and social. WhatsApp is not publicly documented as a native channel in the opened sources. [6] [13]

#### Parent, student and teacher portals

Central Workspace/Experience supplies role-based dashboards for students, faculty, advisors, administrators, technical staff and executives. Students can access classes, grades, schedules, campus updates and guidance; faculty manage classes and academic work; administrators surface payroll, advising and operational tasks. A distinct parent portal is not a primary higher-education product concept. [9]

#### Fees, billing, payments and accounting

Ellucian Finance and Banner/Colleague Finance cover budgeting, forecasting, general ledger, fund accounting, accounts payable/receivable, billing and invoicing, procurement, grants, financial reporting, bank reconciliation, fixed assets and dashboards. Ellucian also offers Payment Center and OneCard by TouchNet, with secure campus transaction processing and PCI-oriented cashless payments. [16] [22]

#### HR, staff and payroll

Ellucian HCM manages employee data, faculty contracts, multiple jobs, student employment, payroll, deferred pay, benefits, position control and sensitive HR data. Employee self-service includes profile changes, timesheets, time-off requests, tax forms and pay history; workforce analytics cover compensation, budget planning, succession and IPEDS/FISAP readiness. [15]

#### Transport

No native bus, route, fleet, driver, pickup or GPS transport module was identified in the official catalog or documentation portal. Institutions would need a partner or third-party integration.

#### Library

No native library circulation, catalog, acquisitions or resource-management module was identified in the opened Ellucian product catalog. Library systems can be connected through the integration layer.

#### Hostel and boarding

No native residence, dormitory, room-allocation, meal-plan or boarding module is publicly documented as part of Banner, Colleague or Ellucian Student.

#### Inventory and assets

Finance supports purchasing, receiving, supplier management, spend management, travel and expense, fixed assets and related financial controls. Capterra’s feature inventory specifically lists fixed-asset management, purchasing/receiving and purchase-order management. [16] [22]

#### Health and medical

No student health-record, clinic, immunization, medication or medical-case module was identified in the public product inventory. Health data may be connected through APIs, but native clinical functionality is not established by the reviewed sources.

#### Behavior, discipline and pastoral care

No K–12 behavior points, discipline casebook, safeguarding/pastoral-care or parent intervention module is advertised. Student Success provides advising case management, alerts and proactive intervention, which is adjacent but not a school-discipline system. [14]

#### Special education and safeguarding

No native individualized education-plan, special-education case-management or child-safeguarding module was found. Ellucian’s security and access controls support regulated institutional data, but they should not be confused with special-education compliance workflows. [7]

#### Alumni and fundraising

CRM Advance and Advancement support constituent and donor information, prospect research, gift processing, giving history, tailored communications, campaign goals, impact dashboards, pledges and online gifts. The documentation portal describes CRM Advance as a cloud solution for alumni and donor relationships; current Advancement pages add predictive models and constituent-preference communications. [2] [8] [3]

#### Analytics, dashboards and reporting

Ellucian Insights/Reporting & Analytics unifies SIS, ERP, CRM and third-party data in a governed warehouse/data lake. It provides pre-built dashboards, role-specific dashboards, data discovery, visualization, analysis, enrollment and course-performance views, financial health, operational KPIs and student-success analytics. The 2024 innovation release added planned predictive AI for retention risk, generative-assisted analytics, natural-language data discovery/chatbot interaction and self-service scheduled Colleague financial reports. [6] [10]

#### AI features

Current Ellucian AI is built around the Ellucian Higher Ed Knowledge Graph, which the company says encodes nearly 10,000 higher-education processes. Features include agentic task execution, AI-powered degree planning and alerts, scholarship matching, predictive retention indicators, workforce and finance recommendations, natural-language analytics, fraud checks, AI-assisted forms and an AI virtual student assistant. Ellucian states that institutional data is not used to train external models and that AI outcomes are explainable, auditable and governed. [3] [17] [18]

#### Government/state reporting and compliance

HCM explicitly references IPEDS and FISAP readiness; Finance references GASB and FASB reporting. The platform provides regulatory-reporting and validation workflows, financial-aid processing and configurable regional solutions. Ellucian’s security page identifies FERPA-oriented higher-education responsibilities as part of its compliance context, but a single public certification matrix for FERPA, COPPA, GDPR and India’s DPDP Act was not found. [7] [15] [16]

#### Mobile apps

Institution-branded Ellucian Mobile/Ellucian Go apps can expose course schedules, grades, account balances/payments, campus news and events, with institution-specific SSO and content. The reviewed App Store listing was native iPhone/iPad; Ellucian’s public Android developer page confirms Android distribution but did not expose an aggregate rating. Capabilities and quality therefore vary by institution and configuration. [23]

#### Integrations and APIs

Ellucian Ethos/Data Orchestration provides low-code integration design, pre-built connectors, serverless APIs, real-time synchronization, third-party data mapping to Insights and extensibility for Ellucian Student. The documentation portal exposes Banner and Colleague Ethos API administration, Web API, API catalogs and developer resources. Partners and named integrations include Canvas, Slate, TouchNet, WebTMA, Axiom, Salesforce/Eventbrite use cases, Microsoft, AWS, IBM and Instructure. [8] [12] [19] [22] [25]

#### Security and privacy

Ellucian Cloud Services reports ISO 27001:2022 certification, annual independent SOC 1/SOC 2 Type II/SOC 3 reports, PCI DSS, CSA, HECVAT, NIST 800-171 and UK Cyber Essentials Basic alignment. It describes 24x7 monitoring, AWS security services, incident response, application-security controls, MFA/customer-center access and responsible disclosure. Public sources reviewed did not disclose a confirmed major incident with date; customers should request current Trust Center artifacts and regional data-processing terms. [7] [8]

### Advanced and Distinctive Features

* **Higher Ed Knowledge Graph:** Ellucian grounds AI in institutional rules, policies, processes and regulations rather than generic prompts. [17]
* **Agentic AI included in subscription:** The current AI pricing page says there are no tokens, credits, per-seat fees or usage meters for included AI. [18]
* **Smart Planning and Registration:** Plans adapt to changed programs, life events and pace, and link directly to policy-aware registration. [14]
* **Credential Discovery:** Degree analysis finds earned or nearly completed credentials outside a student’s declared program and identifies stop-outs close to completion. [14]
* **AI Forms Assistant:** Non-technical staff can generate forms from natural language or upload an existing form for digital recreation. [11]
* **Institution-wide central workspace:** One role-based hub surfaces tasks, insights and alerts across student, finance and HCM systems. [9]
* **Transcript Exchange:** Secure transcript ordering, authentication and fulfillment are treated as an integrated workflow rather than a file export. [2]
* **SaaS migration at higher-ed scale:** Banner and Colleague SaaS preserve sector-specific ERP/SIS depth while moving upgrades, security and infrastructure toward a managed service model. [5]

### Pricing Details

Ellucian does not publish core Banner, Colleague, Ellucian Student, CRM or platform SKU prices, per-student rates, tiers or implementation fees. The official buying path is a demo/contact process; the pricing page reviewed is specifically for AI and says included AI has one core subscription price with no per-seat, token, credit or usage-based charge, but it does not reveal the core subscription amount. [18] Capterra shows “Get Price,” no free trial and contact-vendor pricing for Ellucian Student; its review evidence says implementation, licensing, maintenance and support can be significant, while a 2025 review described unexpected deployment costs. [21] No reliable public per-student or per-school annual range was verified, so third-party estimates are omitted rather than presented as fact. Date checked: 2026-11-24.

### Integrations, Standards and Interoperability

Ethos and Data Orchestration provide the strongest public interoperability evidence: open/serverless APIs, low-code integration design, pre-built connectors, real-time synchronization, custom mapping and an API catalog. The partner catalog is a marketplace-like network for Ellucian-compatible solutions; documented or independently listed connections include Canvas, Slate, TouchNet, WebTMA and Axiom, while GovTech reports the network includes Microsoft, AWS, IBM and Instructure. [12] [19] [22] [25]

The opened official pages do not verify Ellucian as certified for OneRoster, LTI, Ed-Fi or SIF, nor do they document direct Clever or ClassLink certification. Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 are not presented as a universal suite integration in the reviewed product pages, although Microsoft appears in the partner ecosystem and Microsoft Copilot is referenced in Student Success communications. Treat these standards and connectors as institution- or partner-dependent until Ellucian supplies a current certification list. [14] [19]

### Security, Privacy and Compliance

Ellucian publishes a substantive Cloud Security page: ISO 27001:2022, SOC 1/2 Type II/3, PCI DSS, CSA, HECVAT, NIST 800-171 and Cyber Essentials Basic are listed as standards or alignments. AWS Inspector/Tenable vulnerability management, GuardDuty, WAF, Shield DDoS protection, endpoint protection and Splunk SIEM are named controls. The company describes a shared-responsibility model, 24x7 monitoring, incident response aligned with US-CERT/NIST and a responsible-disclosure program. [7]

FERPA, GDPR, COPPA and India’s DPDP Act are not all supported by a public, product-specific certification statement in the opened material; Ellucian instead directs customers to its Trust Center and regional documentation. The reviewed Trust Center landing metadata states the company was founded in 1968, headquartered in Reston and serving 2,800+ customers in 50 countries and 22M students, showing that claims vary by page date. No confirmed major public security incident was found in the sources opened for this profile through 2026-11-24. [7] [8] [26]

### Strengths

* Deep higher-education specialization and a broad system-of-record footprint spanning student, finance, HCM, CRM, advancement and analytics. [1] [2]
* Very large installed base: the current company claim is 21M+ students and approximately 3,000 institutions. [1]
* Banner/Colleague SaaS migration gives institutions a path from established ERP/SIS estates to managed cloud operations. [5]
* Strong academic-progress tooling through Degree Works, Smart Planning, advising, alerts, transfer credit and Credential Discovery. [14]
* Mature integration strategy through Ethos, API catalogs, low-code orchestration and a partner network. [8] [12] [19]
* Current AI strategy combines predictive analytics, workflow/form automation, domain context and agentic execution rather than only a chatbot. [6] [17]
* Security posture is unusually transparent for a higher-ed ERP, with ISO, SOC, PCI and cloud-control disclosures. [7]

### Weaknesses and Common User Complaints

* Usability is mixed: G2 is 3.4/5 and Capterra reports 3.2/5 ease of use for the general Ellucian listing and 3.1/5 for Ellucian Student. [20] [21] [22]
* Reviews frequently describe dated, code-heavy or inconsistent interfaces, long multi-step workflows, difficult report customization and a steep learning curve. [21] [22]
* Implementation and services are recurring pain points: reviewers cite painful implementation, train-the-trainer models that strain small institutions, consultant confusion and costs that exceed initial expectations. [21]
* Support and documentation are uneven in reviews, including inadequate public help materials, slow or ineffective support and changing customer-community tooling. [21]
* SaaS migration has generated complaints about release defects, delays, vendor timetables and loss of institutional control over upgrade schedules. [22]
* Native coverage is not a complete school-management suite: no documented transport, library, hostel, health, special-education or K–12 discipline modules, and no native LMS/homework engine.
* Mobile quality is institution-specific; the opened UL Lafayette listing had 1.4/5 from 14 ratings and reviews citing login, crashing and reliability problems. [23]
* Core pricing, implementation fees and contract units are opaque; buyers must budget through a quote and discovery process. [18] [21]

### Key Milestones

* **1968:** Datatel Inc. established; this is the root company year, not the Ellucian brand year. [4]
* **1979:** SCT introduced Banner and Datatel began development of Colleague. [4]
* **1996:** Datatel and SCT expanded internationally across North America, Europe and beyond. [4]
* **2004:** SunGard acquired SCT; the company says cloud-based solutions began to be introduced. [4]
* **2012:** Datatel and SunGard Higher Education combined; the Ellucian name was announced in March 2012. [4] [24]
* **2015:** TPG Capital and Leonard Green acquired Ellucian, supporting broader cloud and portfolio investment. [4]
* **2021:** Blackstone and Vista Equity Partners invested in Ellucian. [4]
* **2022:** Ellucian acquired CampusLogic, adding student financial-success tools. [4] [25]
* **2023:** Ellucian launched its partner network; the company’s 2024 release reported 79 SaaS ERP/SIS selections in 2023 and 120+ other SaaS selections. [5] [25]
* **2024:** Ellucian announced Journey, Communicate, Intelligent Processes, Colleague Financial Reports and new Insights predictive/generative AI capabilities. [6]
* **2024:** Ellucian acquired EduNav for academic planning, registration and transfer tools. [4] [25]
* **2025:** Ellucian announced/acquired Anthology’s SIS/ERP business; the transaction closed December 31, 2025. [4] [25]
* **2026:** Ellucian positions Student and the Platform as AI-native, with the Higher Ed Knowledge Graph and included AI pricing; current pages claim approximately 3,000 institutions and 21M+ students. [1] [17] [18]

### Overview

Arbor Education is a UK cloud school management information system (MIS) used by schools, MAT central teams and local authorities. It centralises student, staff, attendance, assessment, behaviour, safeguarding, census, communications, payments and operational data in a browser-accessible system. Arbor’s School MIS is sold in Core, Comms and Perform packages; the wider School Management Suite adds Arbor Finance, SAMpeople HR/recruitment, TimeTabler, Workflows and Arbor AI. [1] [5]

The company says Arbor MIS launched in 2011. Its 2020 sale to The Key Support Services transferred Arbor Education Partners to The Key/Darwin Acquisitions; Arbor MIS and Arbor Insight then served more than 1,200 schools and MATs. [2] [10] The Key acquired RM Integris, RM Finance and RM Accounts in June 2023, bringing the group’s cloud MIS brands above 7,000 schools and relaunching RM Finance as Arbor Finance. [11] The current Arbor site claims more than 12,500 schools and 930 MATs, not an independently audited count. [1]

### Platform Classification Explained

**Browser/cloud access.** Arbor says the MIS is not stored on a physical school server and is accessible anywhere with internet. Classroom365 likewise describes browser access, a single cloud login for MATs and dependence on reliable internet/Wi-Fi. [3] [12]

**Hosting.** Arbor says the MIS is hosted in Amazon Web Services’ London region, with personal data and backups in the UK, a private firewalled network, single-tenant database model and AES-256 encryption. [13]

**Desktop/on-premise.** No on-premise Arbor MIS deployment is documented. TimeTabler is listed by Arbor as a separate leading timetabling product, and the 2024/25 rate card states that its Options product is cloud-based but TimeTabler licences are sold separately because TimeTabler is not a cloud product. [1] [14]

**Native mobile.** Arbor has iOS/Android Parent/Guardian and Student apps; the Student App launched in November 2024. [8] [9] [15]

### Complete Feature Inventory

#### Admissions and enrolment

Admissions supports applications through enrolment, applicant records, admissions appeals and appeal numbers, new-student onboarding and year-end/new-school-year setup. Perform includes Admissions, while Workflows can automate new-student admissions and collect form data, reminders, approvals and documents. [5] [16]

#### Student information and records

Student Profiles provide the central record for contacts, relationships, education history, demographic and contextual data, documents, custom fields and data-quality flags. Arbor supports bulk actions, live feeds, duplicate detection, profile exports for subject-access requests, and a shared data model connecting attendance, behaviour, assessment, medical, SEN and communication records. [5] [13]

#### Attendance

The attendance module provides digital registers, configurable attendance codes, statutory attendance calculations, live attendance dashboards, threshold alerts, automated absence follow-up and persistent-absence analysis. The AI layer adds Auto Absence, which listens to, transcribes, translates for EAL families and logs absence-related voicemail for staff approval. [5] [17]

#### Timetable and master scheduling

Arbor displays student and staff timetables, calendars, lesson gaps and clashes, and supports cover management and staff absence workflows. Scheduling is complemented by separate TimeTabler and third-party Edval integrations; Arbor does not claim that its core MIS is a full master-scheduling engine. [1] [14] [18]

#### Gradebook, assessment and examinations

Assessments include flexible marksheets, assessment frameworks, progress tracking, curriculum tracking, intervention tracking, analysis over time, assessment-policy pushdown across MAT schools and attainment drill-down to individual profiles. Perform adds assignments and deeper assessment workflows. Examinations cover exam schedules, qualifications/units, awards, exam-related records and examination census preparation. [5] [6] [16]

#### Report cards and transcripts

Arbor supports student report cards, downloadable report cards in the Parent App, print-preview report cards, targets and progress views. [5] [8]

#### Learning management and homework

The Student App exposes assignments, homework and calendar information, while My Classroom supports classroom management, seating plans, random picker, lesson notes and key student information. Google Classroom integration synchronises Arbor data with a digital learning platform; specialist homework tools such as Show My Homework are available through partners. [5] [9] [18]

#### Communication

Staff can send searchable email and SMS, in-app messages and bulk communications to defined student, parent or staff groups. The Parent and Student Apps provide push-style in-app messages. Arbor’s documented integrations include ParentMail, Teachers2Parents, SchoolComms, Groupcall and other communication providers; WhatsApp is not publicly documented as a native channel. [5] [18]

#### Parent, student and teacher portals

The Parent Portal and Arbor Parent & Guardian App expose attendance, behaviour points, academic progress, report cards, timetables, homework, medical updates, clubs, trips, consultation bookings and payments. The Student Portal/App provides calendar, announcements, attendance, behaviour points, assignments, biometric login and Ask Arbor. Staff use the browser MIS, My Classroom and role dashboards; no separate native teacher app is evidenced. [5] [8] [9] [15]

#### Fees, billing, payments and accounting

Payments Core handles trips, clubs, meals, wraparound care, account top-ups, cash/card/cheque/childcare-voucher payments, manual and bulk invoices, cashless-catering integrations, reconciliation reporting and multi-bank-account payouts. Payments Plus adds school shop, automatic student/group pricing, Apple Pay, Google Pay, rotating meal menus and parent meal choice. [19] [11]

#### HR, staff and payroll

Staff Management covers staff profiles, contracts, positions, qualifications, checks, absences, cover and appraisals; MAT MIS adds central-team HR records and a Single Central Record. Workforce Census workflows require positions, contracts and staff data. SAMpeople is the group’s separate HR/recruitment product; payroll is not listed as a core Arbor MIS module. [5] [6] [16]

#### Transport, library, hostel and boarding

No native transport routing, library circulation, hostel/boarding or dormitory module is publicly listed for Arbor MIS. These areas can be handled through specialist integrations or external systems. Independent-school and FE product pages do not establish a native boarding or library subsystem, so these capabilities should not be assumed. [1] [18]

#### Inventory and assets

Arbor Workflows includes an asset library and can capture data, documents, approvals and operational processes; MAT packages list an asset library. This is workflow-oriented asset/process management, not a clearly documented fixed-asset register, procurement or barcode inventory module. [6] [16]

#### Health and medical

Medical Tracker logs medical conditions, incidents, medication and care plans, with access and filtering from any device. Perform includes Medical Tracker, and medical information can be updated through the Parent App. [5] [8] [18]

#### Behaviour, discipline and pastoral care

Behaviour records positive and negative points, rewards, reports and detentions. Dashboards connect behaviour with attendance and attainment, while interventions record provision and effectiveness over time. Safeguarding/pastoral partners such as CPOMS and MyConcern integrate through Arbor’s partner ecosystem. [5] [18]

#### Special education and safeguarding

SEN tracks pupils, provision and funding, complex medical/educational needs, review evidence and alerts on attendance, behaviour or progress. Arbor’s granular permissions can restrict child-protection data, and safeguarding systems such as CPOMS and MyConcern are approved integrations. [5] [13] [18]

#### Alumni and fundraising

Alumni relations, fundraising campaigns and donor management are not publicly listed as native Arbor modules. Schools would need external systems or integrations for those functions. [1] [18]

#### Analytics, dashboards and reporting

Role dashboards, custom Report Writer, scheduled reports, live national benchmarking against DfE/Ofsted and Arbor’s national database, BI Connector, BI Viewer, live feeds, Data Warehouse and MAT trust-wide dashboards support operational and strategic analysis. MAT users can compare schools, drill down to staff and students, set attendance thresholds and push assessment, pay-scale, permissions and user-defined-field policies. [5] [6]

#### AI features

Arbor AI includes Ask Arbor natural-language answers, Smart Reports including an Ofsted Inspection Companion, instant student summaries, email/letter/SMS drafting and translation, formula suggestions, and Auto Absence transcription/translation/logging. Arbor reports 4,000+ schools using Arbor AI and says customer data is not used to train providers’ models; it identifies OpenAI, Microsoft Azure, Google Gemini and Snowflake among relevant subprocessors/providers. [17] [13]

#### Government/state reporting and compliance

For England, Arbor supports School Census and Workforce Census preparation, dry runs, error/query resolution, census summaries, COLLECT/LA submission files and submission checklists. The Help Centre documents 2026/27 census dates and DfE guidance. Statutory reporting, custom reports, census audit and school-year setup audit are also packaged for MAT central teams. [5] [16] [20] [21]

#### Mobile apps

The Parent & Guardian app is available for iPhone and Android and manages family information, attendance, behaviour, progress, payments, clubs, trips, consultations, report cards and homework. The Student App is available for iPhone/iPad and Android, with announcements, calendar, attendance, behaviour, assignments, biometric login and Ask Arbor. App-store ratings are materially weaker than Arbor’s vendor satisfaction claims. [8] [9] [15]

#### Integrations and APIs

Arbor exposes an open RESTful API and partner-approval console with read/write permissions where supported, explicit data-access review, approval/rejection and revocation. Named integrations include Wonde, Groupcall, ParentPay, CPOMS, LGfL, OTrack, Cunninghams, ClassCharts, Studybugs, Scopay, Google Classroom, Microsoft 365/Teams, Office 365, G Suite, cashless catering, assessment, safeguarding, payments and BI tools. [6] [18]

#### Security and privacy

Arbor documents ISO 27001, ISO 9001, Cyber Essentials, DfE cloud-supplier checklist and G-Cloud status, UK AWS hosting, role-based access, password rules, optional/enforced two-factor authentication for staff, inactivity logout, audit trails, data-retention dashboards, SAR exports, 30-day restore capability and AES-256 encryption. It publicly states GDPR/UK GDPR compliance; FERPA, COPPA and India’s DPDP Act are not claimed as product certifications. No independently verified public breach was found in the sources reviewed; Arbor describes incident-response and breach-notification procedures. [3] [13] [22]

### Advanced and Distinctive Features

- **Ask Arbor and Ofsted Inspection Companion:** Natural-language answers and an editable inspection pack reduce report preparation and navigation time. [17]
- **Auto Absence:** Voicemail transcription, translation and absence-code suggestions turn a repetitive attendance workflow into an approval queue. [17]
- **MAT policy pushdown:** Trust teams can push assessment frameworks, pay scales, permissions and UDFs to schools while retaining local autonomy. [6]
- **Live national benchmarking:** Schools can compare their data with DfE/Ofsted benchmarks and Arbor’s live national dataset. [5]
- **Arbor Workflows:** A drag-and-drop builder combines triggers, forms, checklists, reminders, schedules, conditional logic, documents, emails and audit trails. [16]
- **Integrated payments:** Trips, clubs, meals, shops, childcare vouchers, Apple Pay and Google Pay sit beside student and communications data. [19]
- **UK statutory workflow depth:** Dry runs and error resolution for School and Workforce Census are designed around DfE/COLLECT processes. [20] [21]

### Pricing Details

Arbor has no current public web pricing page; the most specific official public source is the 2024/25 G-Cloud 14 rate card, so figures below are historical and not a November 2026 quote. Core, Comms and Perform were priced annually by student plus a school base fee: primary £3.15/£6.30/£10.50 per student plus £2,100 base; secondary £4.20/£7.35/£11.55 plus £4,200; FE/sixth-form/UTC £4.20/£7.35/£11.55 plus £4,725. Core included attendance, behaviour, progress, census, reports, profiles and email/SMS; Comms added portals/apps, parents’ evening, meals and payments; Perform added curriculum/intervention tracking, provision map, assignments, My Classroom, seating plans, shop and staff performance. [14]

The rate card listed MAT Essentials/Plus/Enterprise at a £1,500 year-one setup fee, annual per-student charges of £0.50/£1.00/£1.50 and base fees of £2,500/£2,500/£3,500, with extra data-warehouse/HR integration charges. Onboarding ranged from free for standard primary migration to £2,500 for secondary onboarding, plus optional training and programme management. Discounts scaled by institution count. Current tiers and prices are quote-based and may have changed. [14]

### Integrations, Standards and Interoperability

Arbor has an open RESTful API, partner-app permission management and an integration ecosystem exceeding 130 support partners/apps by the company’s count. It supports or connects to Wonde, Groupcall, ParentPay, CPOMS, ParentMail, Teachers2Parents, SchoolComms, cashless-catering providers, Edval, Google Classroom, Google Workspace/G Suite, Microsoft 365/Teams, Office 365, Excel, Power BI, Google Data Studio and BI/data-warehouse tooling. [6] [18]

The reviewed materials do not establish OneRoster, LTI, Ed-Fi or SIF certification, Clever/ClassLink certification or a formal marketplace. API access is often partner-mediated: schools must approve apps and cannot independently customise every permission set. [6] [13]

### Security, Privacy and Compliance

Arbor publicly reports ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certification, Cyber Essentials, PCI DSS 4.0 for payments, DfE cloud-supplier checklist and G-Cloud approval. It says data is hosted in AWS London, with UK personal-data storage and backups, UK GDPR/GDPR compliance, AES-256 encryption, RBAC, two-factor authentication, access/login histories, annual penetration testing and 30-day restore. [13] [22]

The compliance guide names AWS, Stripe, Microsoft, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Snowflake, Twilio/SendGrid, Vonage and other subprocessors in the UK, EEA and US. Public materials do not claim FERPA or COPPA certification, and no Arbor-specific India DPDP Act statement was found. No independently verified public security incident was identified; Arbor says it will notify customers of breaches affecting their data. [13]

### Strengths

- Broad UK school/MAT coverage, especially attendance, census, communications, assessment, behaviour and reporting.
- Coherent School MIS–MAT MIS data with central dashboards, policy pushdowns, native payments, parent/student apps and statutory workflows.
- Explicit UK AWS hosting, ISO 27001, GDPR tooling, API permission review, data-retention/SAR features and a large partner ecosystem.

### Weaknesses and Common User Complaints

- Parent and student mobile UX is a material weakness: Apple ratings were 1.9/5 for Parent and 1.3/5 for Student on 24 November 2026, with reviews describing confusing navigation, login failures, slow loading, random logouts and homework-submission problems. [8] [9]
- Trustpilot showed a 1.2/5 TrustScore from 173 reviews on the same date; its review summary reported complaints about confusing/intuitive design, slow performance, errors and support friction, although Trustpilot does not fact-check review claims. [7]
- Cloud delivery improves access but makes stable internet, Wi-Fi, browser/device configuration and account administration operational dependencies. [12]
- Several functions are not native in the MIS itself: payroll, full accounting, transport, library, boarding, alumni/fundraising and full master scheduling require separate suite products or third parties.
- Public interoperability is integration-rich but not standards-rich: the reviewed evidence does not show OneRoster/LTI/Ed-Fi/SIF certification, a formal marketplace or Clever/ClassLink certification.
- Pricing is not transparently maintained on the public site; schools generally need a quote, and historic rate-card prices should not be assumed current.

### Key Milestones

- **2011:** Arbor says it launched Arbor MIS. [2]
- **2011–2019:** James Weatherill and Emile Axelrad are identified as founders in Crunchbase; Crunchbase does not expose a reliable founding date or funding totals publicly. [23]
- **2018 onward:** Arbor’s partner ecosystem and API integrations expanded to cover payments, safeguarding, assessment, communications, identity and catering providers. [18]
- **2020:** Arbor Education Partners was sold to The Key Support Services, part of Darwin Acquisitions; the transaction described Arbor MIS and Arbor Insight as serving 1,200+ schools/MATs. [10]
- **2023:** The Key completed its acquisition of RM Integris, RM Finance and RM Accounts; the group said Arbor, ScholarPack and RM Integris together supported more than 7,000 schools, and RM Finance became Arbor Finance. [11]
- **2024:** Arbor launched the Student App for iOS and Android, adding direct student communications, calendar, attendance, behaviour, assignments and an AI assistant in Labs. [15]
- **2026:** Arbor’s site lists Arbor AI, Smart Reports/Ofsted Inspection Companion, Auto Absence and Arbor Workflows as current products/features; it claims 12,500+ schools, 930 MATs and 4,000+ schools using Arbor AI. [1] [17]

## #4. Alma SIS (Alma Technologies, Inc.)

| Field | Detail |
|---|---|
| Vendor / owner | Alma Technologies, Inc.; privately held US education-software company |
| Headquarters | 909 N. Beech St., Suite 210, Portland, Oregon 97227, United States [1] |
| Company founded (year) | 2014 is best supported: Tech.co reports February 2014 and G2 lists 2014; PitchBook and Tracxn instead list 2012 and 2013. [7] [8] [14] [17] |
| Product first launched (year or Not publicly disclosed) | 2014 (inferred from the company launch and 2015 reporting that Alma was already deployed); Alma has not published a separate product-launch date. [8] |
| Platform classification (Cloud SaaS / Web-based / Desktop / Mobile iOS+Android / On-premise / Hybrid) | Cloud-native browser SaaS with responsive “Alma Now” mobile portal; no desktop client, school-level on-premise option or verified native iOS/Android listing. State offerings can be Alma-, SEA- or hybrid-hosted. [2] [3] [4] [5] |
| Primary segments | US K–12 independent, charter, private/international schools, public districts, multi-school networks, state education agencies, and departments of education. |

| Product / features page (full URL) | https://www.getalma.com/solutions/ |
